open.title: Open the till
open.description: Count the cash in the drawer to start the shift.

movement.title: Cash in / out
movement.description: Money put into or taken out of the drawer. The drawer opens and it's recorded with your name.

close.title: Close the till
close.description: Count the cash in the drawer and type the total. You'll see what was expected afterwards.
close.descriptionForced: Count the cash in the drawer for them and type the total. It's recorded as closed by you.
close.withSales: Include every sale in the report
close.quickQuestion: Nothing was sold or taken out: is the cash still the opening float ({{amount}})?
close.quickHint: If it is, close in one click. If not, type what's in the drawer.

page.description: Each till shift with its cash count. Differences are shown in red.
page.empty: No shifts yet. Turn on cash counting in Settings.

others.title: {{name}}'s shift is still open
others.description: {{name}} opened this till at {{time}} and hasn't closed it. Sales wait until it's closed.
others.askManager: Ask {{name}} or a manager to close it.

backOffice.title: This device is for back office
backOffice.description: It doesn't sell and never opens a shift. Selling happens on a till.
backOffice.change: Make this device a till (This device)
backOffice.askManager: Ask a manager to make it a till.

deviceRole.question: Is this device a till (sells) or back office?
deviceRole.hint: Asked once on this device. A till opens a shift with a float when someone sells; back office never does. You can change it in This device.
deviceRole.askManager: Ask a manager to set this device up as a till.
